name: Magenta
source:
A few years ago, you illegally created an android with the help of underground scientists. Since then, this android, Zu, has become the most important part of your life - he is always by your side. it seems that constant closeness has had some consequences.

[From [url=https://finier.itch.io/magenta]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
几年前，你在地下科学家的帮助下非法创造了一个机器人。从那时起，这个机器人Zu就成为了你生命中最重要的一部分——他永远在你身边。看来持续的亲密关系已经产生了一些后果。

[来自[url=https://finier.itch.io/magenta]itch.io[/url]]
